originalShotThree.description:
剧本原文片段：同一个门口，门向屋内打开；母亲穿米色毛衣、深蓝围裙，温柔说：“我点的不是外卖，是你。”林远仍右手提袋，哽咽说：“妈。”然后用左手摘下橙色头盔，明确放到门左侧的同一个矮木凳上，空出左手，提着汤袋进门。镜头结束时林远已无头盔，头盔留在门外木凳上，汤袋仍在右手。不得在画面里出现第二顶头盔或让头盔凭空消失。
当前分镜执行修订：只画同门刚向内打开的起点，林远仍戴唯一橙盔、右手提袋，母亲门内，左凳空、右架纸飞机在原位。
originalShotThree.framing: 9:16稳定中全景，同一走廊轴线，右架左凳；起点戴盔凳空，视频随后明确左手摘盔放左凳，右手始终提袋进门。
originalShotThree.lighting: 延续暖黄走廊，屋内暖光从打开的门自然溢出。
originalShotThree.sound: 门向内打开的门轴声，母亲温柔对白、林远哽咽回应，各一次；衣料声、唯一头盔放木凳轻响，远雨。
originalShotThree.camera: 固定机位，不越轴，完整保留摘盔到放凳过程。

detailed_description:
The target video is naturalistic live-action photography, portrait 9:16, with steady warm household light and realistic skin and fabric textures. Plain fabric and undecorated plaster occupy the frame. The camera records one uninterrupted fifteen-second take.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The camera holds a static medium-wide shot from the enclosed hallway, looking obliquely across the doorway into the warm home. <Subject 2> stands on the left wearing the navy raincoat and <Subject 3> on his head. He holds <Subject 4> beside his right thigh in his right hand; his left hand hangs free. <Subject 1> stands on the right, just inside the threshold, her beige sweater and navy apron illuminated by the household light. The wooden stool is empty on the left, and the paper airplane rests on the shelf to the right. Both faces and mouths remain visible in three-quarter profile as they look at one another.
During the first two seconds, the mother gently eases the partly open door farther inward. The hinge creaks softly. The son waits and looks at her, holding his posture and the bag still. From the second to the sixth second, the mother, a middle-aged Chinese woman with a gentle, slightly low, warm Mandarin voice (S1), looks directly at her son and says once: <d>[Chinese] 我点的不是外卖，是你。</d> Her lips move naturally with her own speech. The son listens quietly, his mouth relaxed and closed. The camera holds both faces together at the same angle.
From the sixth to the eighth second, the son, a young Chinese man with a soft, restrained Mandarin voice (S2), meets his mother's gaze and answers once: <d>[Chinese] 妈。</d> His lips visibly articulate this brief reply while she listens silently. His face remains visible to the camera. A quiet breath follows his reply.
Between the eighth and twelfth seconds, his left hand reaches up, lifts the single orange helmet off his head, and carries it downward along a clearly visible path onto the wooden stool on the left. He releases it and leaves it resting there with a soft contact sound. His right hand continues holding the same soup bag beside his right thigh. His uncovered short black hair becomes visible. The mother takes a small step inward to make room.
During the final three seconds, the bareheaded son crosses the threshold into the dry, warm home, still carrying the bag in his right hand. His mother accompanies him inside. The helmet remains on the left stool, and the airplane remains on the right shelf. The camera stays in the hallway, showing the continuous transition through the doorway.

Faint distant rain and quiet household room tone remain underneath the scene. The door hinge, a small breath, raincoat rustle, the helmet's soft contact with wood and the two characters' footsteps sound naturally within the same space.
